title: An Invariant Neural-Network Eddy-Viscosity Closure with Iterative Solver Coupling for Molten Salt Fast Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
abstract: arXiv:2611.17067v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: System thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) close turbulence on coarse meshes with algebraic zero-equation mixing-length models. These models cannot represent the non-equilibrium turbulence, flow separation, and large-scale recirculation of open-cavity advanced reactors. We develop an invariant neural-network eddy-viscosity closure for SAM and apply it to the Molten Salt Fast Reactor (MSFR). The closure predicts the turbulent kinetic energy and timescale of each element from the flow and geometry of its neighbors, without solving turbulence transport equations. The resulting non-negative eddy viscosity enters the implicit diffusive operator, which keeps the momentum equations well conditioned. We prove that the closure is exactly invariant to translation, Galilean boost, rotation, reflection, and neighbor ordering. A network trained on high-order Nek5000 fields sees a different feature distribution

translated_title: 用于熔盐快堆热工水力学的具有迭代求解器耦合的不变性神经网络涡粘性闭合模型
translated_abstract: 系统级热工水力分析程序（如系统分析模块SAM）在粗网格上采用代数零方程混合长度模型来闭合湍流。这些模型无法表征开放腔体式先进反应堆中的非平衡湍流、流动分离和大尺度回流现象。我们为SAM开发了一种不变性神经网络涡粘性闭合模型，并将其应用于熔盐快堆（MSFR）。该闭合模型根据邻近单元的流动与几何特征预测每个单元的湍动能和时间尺度，而无需求解湍流输运方程。由此得到的非负涡粘性进入隐式扩散算子，从而保持动量方程的良好条件性。我们证明了该闭合模型对平移、伽利略变换、旋转、反射以及邻居排序具有严格的不变性。在高阶Nek5000流场上训练得到的网络面对不同的特征分布（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文为SAM系统热工水力程序开发了一种对平移、旋转、反射等变换严格不变的神经网络涡粘性闭合模型，无需求解湍流输运方程即可预测非负涡粘性并保持动量方程良好条件性，将其应用于熔盐快堆以捕捉传统混合长度模型无法表征的非平衡湍流与大规模回流。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a provably invariant neural-network eddy-viscosity closure for SAM that predicts non-negative eddy viscosity from neighbor flow and geometry without solving turbulence transport equations, and applies it to Molten Salt Fast Reactor thermal-hydraulics to capture non-equilibrium turbulence, flow separation, and large-scale recirculation beyond mixing-length models.
